page.overview:
Who is Cyril?

Cyril is a major character in Fetch, the first story in Fazbear Frights 2: Fetch. He is a timid teenage boy who gets dragged into undesired situations by his friend Greg.

Cyril is short and skinny with boyish features and limp brown hair.

In the graphic novel, his hair appears to be cut in a bowl cut.

Cyril is rather timid and somewhat pessimistic. He is also very nerdy and enjoys spending time with his mother, which makes him the target of bullies. Cyril is also shown to be easily pressured into doing things, especially by Greg.
